name: konsensus
description: Jurisdiction-neutral API-backed white-label frontend and deployable conformance instance

scripts.boundary: bun run topology && bun scripts/repository/verify-public-boundary.ts && bun test apps/platform-web/tests/neutral-boundary.test.ts scripts/repository/verify-public-boundary.test.ts
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run boundary && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.test: bun test --timeout 30000 apps/platform-web/lib apps/platform-web/tests instances/conformance-demo/src packages/instance-profile/src packages/proof/src packages/public-api/src scripts/repository/harden-publication.test.ts scripts/repository/resolve-scanner-release.test.ts scripts/repository/verify-public-boundary.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && bun --cwd=apps/platform-web run typecheck && bun --cwd=packages/proof run typecheck && bun --cwd=packages/public-api run typecheck
